project_title: Intratumoral and fecal microbiota reveals microbial markers associated with gastric carcinogenesis
project_description: Meta-analysis reanalyzing 16S rRNA sequencing data from 394 fecal/stool samples (plus 1,642 gastric biopsy samples) across 11 independent studies of gastric cancer (GC) patients vs healthy individuals, using LEfSe (LDA>2.0, p<0.05) to identify genus-level differential taxa in gut microbiota.
citation: Wang et al. 2024, Front Cell Infect Microbiol, PMID 39355268
notes: Fecal/gut microbiota. LEfSe-identified genus enriched in GC vs normal (also GC-enriched in gastric tissue; part of the Lactobacillus+Streptococcus fecal diagnostic marker combo, AUC=0.7949). Exact LDA/p-value not extractable from available text.

project_title: Distinct signatures in the human gut and oral microbiomes of gastric cancer
project_description: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing of 312 stool samples from a total of 317 gastric cancer (GC) patients and chronic-gastritis (disease-free-appearing) controls across two independent Shanghai cohorts, with species-level differential abundance testing (Wilcoxon rank-sum, MaAsLin2, ANCOM-BC; FDR<0.05 in cohort 1, validated at nominal p<0.05 in cohort 2).
citation: Qin et al. 2026, Cell Rep Med, PMID 42013850
notes: Gut/stool species enriched in GC vs chronic-gastritis controls; strongest of the GC-associated Streptococcus species, confirmed via strain-level analysis as oral-to-gut transmitted. Exact p/q-value not extractable from available text.
